tasks.objective: Switch the late-bound operation to the alternate provider, then change only its false-branch fallback offset.

steps.instruction: Select alternate. Preserve the entry implementation and fallback behavior.
Change the fallback offset to minus one and preserve the operation binding.

tasks.objective: Pin the entry call to the primary provider, then change the right operand's offset.

steps.instruction: Pin the current operation call to primary. Keep the selected late provider alternate.
Change the right operand's offset to minus three without reverting the pin.

tasks.objective: Reverse the two equal-valued argument effects, then adjust only the false branch.

steps.instruction: Reverse the two arguments so the right effect precedes the left. Preserve all result values.
Change only the fallback offset to three. Keep the reversed effect order for the true branch.
